comment: FullyPlayableCreateACharacterSystemExperience (Create a Character System 3.21): who plays Cloud's place, on the CHARACTER page. Cloud stays the game's own; every character has its own CharaSpec rows, packs, blueprints, AI blueprint, weapons and voice (FullyPlayableCreateACharacterSystemExperience_P). Picking either Sephiroth also puts Evil Cloud in Sephiroth's place and Bizarro Sephiroth in Alexander's. (3.22) Each character has a title screen of its own ("title": its weapon in the Buster Sword's place, its effect, its menu colour; "values" on BGMList's bgm_prelude: its music). (3.23) VINCENT plays his REVELATION base form: his weapon abilities and limits in Cloud's ("rows": their UniqueId kept, so the save keeps their progress), Triangle and the air Triangle his gunplay ("values" on pt_Cloud's KeyAssignAbilityID_Array). Every pick plays with raised stats while it has Cloud's place ("values": PlayerParameter Cloud01-99 and Cloud's weapons: attack and magic attack about double Cloud's, the rest at the game's caps); Cloud's own are the game's. VINCENT's hits also fill his ATB twice as fast (his own BattleDamageSource rows' hit bonus).

characters.name: YOUNG SEPHIROTH
characters.note: Young Sephiroth (Fully Playable Young Sephiroth): his own rows, blueprint, AI, Masamune, voice and forms; Evil Cloud takes Sephiroth's place, Bizarro Sephiroth Alexander's and the feeler Neo Bahamut Neo Bahamut's while he is picked; stats raised while in Cloud's place (attack and magic attack about double Cloud's; HP 9999, MP 999, the rest at the game's caps)

characters.name: SEPHIROTH
characters.note: Sephiroth (Fully Playable Sephiroth): the game's Sephiroth blueprint and Masamune on his own rows, his forms; Evil Cloud takes Sephiroth's place, Bizarro Sephiroth Alexander's and the feeler Neo Bahamut Neo Bahamut's while he is picked; stats raised while in Cloud's place (attack and magic attack about double Cloud's; HP 9999, MP 999, the rest at the game's caps)

characters.name: VINCENT
characters.note: Vincent (Fully Playable Vincent): his own rows, blueprint, AI, Quicksilver and voice; Dirge moves, Galian Beast and Chaos; (3.23) REVELATION base form: gunplay on Triangle, his own weapon abilities and limits; stats raised while in Cloud's place (attack and magic attack about double Cloud's; HP 9999, MP 999, the rest at the game's caps); his ATB fills twice as fast from his hits

characters.name: SORA
characters.note: Sora (Fully Playable Sora, KINGDOM HEARTS): his own rows on his own sets, his blueprints, Kingdom Key, voice; stats raised while in Cloud's place (attack and magic attack about double Cloud's; HP 9999, MP 999, the rest at the game's caps)

characters.name: ZACK
characters.note: Zack Fair: each playable Cloud costume uses matching Zack base and NoBattle CharaSpec rows duplicated from the exact Cloud rows, preserving each Cloud CharaID and row data. No Zack Reserve rows are created. Uses pt_Zack combat data in Cloud's place; all Cloud weapon choices use the Buster Sword row for now.

characters.name: BARRET
characters.note: Barret: Cloud-slot playable clone. Resident rows are duplicated from the matching Cloud rows, preserving Cloud CharaID and row data; ContentsModel points to Barret's native models where a matching outfit exists, otherwise their standard model. All Cloud weapon selections use the Buster Sword for this pass.
